messages.content: Ryan plants 2 flowers a day in his garden. After 15 days, he notices that 5 of the flowers did not grow. On the same days, he also planted 3 tomatoes per day in his vegetable patch, but all of them grew successfully. How many flowers does he have in his garden?

content.text:
Ryan plants 2 flowers a day for 15 days, so he planted 2 × 15 = 30 flowers.

Since 5 did not grow, he has 30 − 5 = **25 flowers** in his garden.
